benchmarkTitle: MediRoute Dispatch & Routing Benchmark: Hospital Network Bed Saturation
scenarioDescription: High initial occupancy and diversion status testing capacity-aware multi-criteria matching.
simulationNotice: ALL DATA IN THIS BENCHMARK IS SYNTHETICALLY GENERATED FOR ALGORITHM COMPARISON

totalIncidents.name: Total Incidents
totalIncidents.description: Total number of synthetic emergency incidents generated in the scenario.

completedIncidentCount.name: Completed Incidents
completedIncidentCount.description: Number of emergency incidents where an ambulance reached the scene and transported the patient to a hospital.

unservedIncidentCount.name: Unserved Incidents
unservedIncidentCount.description: Number of incidents that could not be served due to resource exhaustion, hospital capacity deficit, or timeout.

unservedIncidentRate.name: Unserved Incident Rate
unservedIncidentRate.description: Ratio of unserved incidents to total generated incidents (unserved / total). Lower is better.

meanResponseTimeMinutes.name: Mean Response Time
meanResponseTimeMinutes.description: Arithmetic mean duration elapsed between incident generation and ambulance arrival at the scene. Lower is better.

medianResponseTimeMinutes.name: Median Response Time
medianResponseTimeMinutes.description: 50th percentile (P50) duration from incident generation to ambulance arrival at the scene. Lower is better.

p95ResponseTimeMinutes.name: P95 Response Time
p95ResponseTimeMinutes.description: 95th percentile duration from incident generation to ambulance arrival at the scene. Lower is better.

minResponseTimeMinutes.name: Minimum Response Time
minResponseTimeMinutes.description: Fastest recorded response time in the scenario.

maxResponseTimeMinutes.name: Maximum Response Time
maxResponseTimeMinutes.description: Slowest recorded response time among completed incidents.

meanTransitTimeMinutes.name: Mean Hospital Transit Time
meanTransitTimeMinutes.description: Mean transit time from incident pickup scene to hospital emergency department admission.

averageAlgorithmComputeTimeMs.name: Algorithm Compute Latency
averageAlgorithmComputeTimeMs.description: Average wall-clock computation time per dispatch decision calculation.

routeCorrectness.name: Route Correctness
routeCorrectness.description: Fraction of planned corridors that traversed non-closed roads and successfully connected origin to destination.

ambulanceUtilization.name: Ambulance Fleet Utilization
ambulanceUtilization.description: Average fraction of total simulation time that ambulances spent active on dispatch missions.

facilityBedUtilization.name: Hospital Bed Utilization
facilityBedUtilization.description: Average occupancy fraction of receiving hospital emergency bed capacity over the simulation timeline.
